messages:
sarah_support: FYI customer ACME Inc opened a billing dispute — invoice INV-2025-08-07 shows 18,245,890 tokens billed but their dashboard (org: acme-prod) shows ~3,205,112. Customer is asking for a refund + explanation.

nate_csm: putting this on high priority. Do they want a full refund or just an adjustment? any SLA impact?

mike_finance: need a short revrec note if we refund. Also want a provisional credit amount to avoid customer churn while eng investigates.

ashley_eng: can you drop a sample request-id + timeframe? there are a couple known metering edge cases that can double-count when streaming falls back to polling and client retries.

sarah_support: sample info below (from customer support ticket):
```
customer org: acme-prod
invoice: INV-2025-08-07
time window: 2025-08-01T00:00:00Z -> 2025-08-07T23:59:59Z
example X-Request-Id: r-9f1b2c3a-17
endpoint: POST /v1/generate (model: open-redwood-large, batch embedding endpoint used by internal job)
notes: customer runs nightly bulk embedding job + streaming fallback for a subset. They say they did not change SDK.
```

billing-bot: Metering summary (auto): total_tokens=18245890; unique_sessions=2; events=1243; most_common_reason=chunked_retry_detected. See /internal/meters/18245 for raw feed.

ashley_eng: thanks. I pulled the raw feed for r-9f1b2c3a — I see two metering events with the same upstream_request_id but different token counts (3,104,512 and 15,141,378). They look like duplicate meter writes from the batching worker when a streaming fallback retried the same payload.

ashley_eng: root cause hypothesis: metering pipeline currently dedupes on meter_event_id but not on upstream_request_id. if client retried without identical meter_event_id we end up double-counting. repro steps: run bulk embed job + simulate streaming->poll fallback (sdk v0.9.2) and trigger an early connection reset. I can repro locally.

mike_finance: provisional approach: grant a provisional credit for the disputed delta while eng confirms. what's the delta once you dedupe?

ashley_eng: initial quick dedupe (hash by upstream_request_id) reduces billed tokens from 18,245,890 -> 3,205,112 (delta ~15,040,778). I'll run a backfill job to reconcile historical events in the invoice window to produce a final delta.

mike_finance: ok. for accounting I need a revrec note: "Provisional refund issued for INV-2025-08-07 due to duplicate metering events. Final adjustment pending engineering backfill and reconciliation." Please also tag the GL code: 7001-refunds-temp.

nate_csm: Sarah, confirm language to customer before issuing provisional credit. we should avoid overpromising ETA.

sarah_support: Draft message to customer: "Thanks — we've identified duplicate metering events triggered by a streaming fallback edge case. We're issuing a provisional credit for the disputed amount while our engineering team backfills and confirms the final adjustment. We'll follow up with the final reconciliation within 72 hours." happy to tweak.

mike_finance: good. approve provisional credit up to $X (calc based on token rate) — finance will post the provisional credit and put the invoice on hold. add the revrec note when you post. CC me on the ledger entry.

ashley_eng: I'll do the following: 1) patch metering pipeline to dedupe on upstream_request_id (PR + canary in 3 hrs), 2) run backfill job for 2025-08-01 -> 2025-08-07 to compute final delta, 3) output reconciliation csv and tag billing team. I will push the reconciliation and resulting token delta here once done.

sarah_support: thanks. I'll send the draft message to the customer now and note the provisional credit + 72h ETA.

billing-bot: Ticket updated: dispute/INV-2025-08-07 marked provisional_credit=true; owner=ashley_eng; followup_eta=72h; ledger_tag=7001-refunds-temp.

mike_finance: once ashley posts the reconciliation, finance will finalize the adjustment and close the provisional credit. please include final token delta and dollar amount.

ashley_eng: acknowledging. will post back with PR link + backfill results. estimated final delta ~15,040,778 tokens (subject to backfill).

sarah_support: noted — I'll keep customer updated and move to closed/won once finance completes the adjustment. thanks team :thumbsup:
